notes: msPerDraw is (T(2N) - T(N)) / N for a pass of N draws paired with a pass of 2N draws, which cancels the render pass fixed cost exactly. N is calibrated per config so the N-draw pass clears minMsPerMeasurement.
Additive blending is enabled on the colour target. Without it this GPU's tiler culls the repeated identical draws in a pass and the measured time becomes physically impossible.

passFixedMsMedian is the by-product 2*T(N) - T(2N). It is a difference of two ~50 ms passes, so it is only good to a few hundred microseconds and can come out negative; it is a sanity check that the pass fixed cost is small, not a measurement.
nsPerEvalPerPixel = slope / pixelCount. netNsPerEvalPerPixel subtracts the null variant slope, i.e. the per-iteration Shape load, address math and accumulate; it is the field arithmetic alone.

scalesWithK is the correctness gate: it requires r2 >= 0.95 on the slope fit AND at least a 2x rise from the smallest to the largest K. If it is false for a real candidate, the compiler defeated the anti-hoisting and the slope means nothing.
